text:
alex_w: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups for the canary rollback incident. Need owners & ETA for action items.

maria_p: Thanks. Can we list the actionable items and owners? I'm happy to drive tracking.

cheng_l: From the postmortem notes:
- Auto-rollback tuning (root cause: noisy signal, false positives)
- Feature-flag scoping defaults (some flags were global by mistake)
- Blast-radius hard caps for config-driven rollouts

sam_k: I'll take flag scoping. Proposal: new default = limited-scope + explicit opt-in. Timeline: PR by EOW, rollout in 2 sprints.

julie_r: I'll own blast-radius hard caps. Plan: add config in rollout service with max-percentage and circuit-breaker. Need telemetry first.

alex_w: cheng_l — can you own auto-rollback tuning? Specifically: 1) separate signal for infra vs. user errors, 2) add debounce window, 3) add dry-run mode.

cheng_l: Yep. Draft plan:
1) metric split: success_rate_{client,error_class}
2) debounce: 3m sliding window
3) dry-run: flag auto-rollback.dry_run=true
I'll open RFC + PR by next Tue.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026-1134 linked: https://incidents.internal/2026-1134 — timeline and logs attached.

maria_p: For tracking — I created a shared board and added cards: "auto-rollback tuning", "flag scoping default", "blast-radius caps". Owners assigned.

alex_w: Ownership + due dates:
- cheng_l: Auto-rollback tuning — RFC by 2026-04-01, PR by 2026-04-05.
- sam_k: Flag scoping defaults — PR by 2026-03-30.
- julie_r: Blast-radius caps — telemetry spike plan by 2026-03-29, PR by 2026-04-07.

sam_k: Quick note on implementation pattern: we should prefer server-side scoping in rollout service rather than client flags so rollback is instant. Example config:
```
rollout:
  max_pct: 20
  scope: "team:ids"
  circuit_breaker: {
    threshold: 0.05,
    window: "5m"
  }
```

julie_r: Agreed. I'll add a test harness to simulate noisy traffic and ensure no false-positive rollbacks.

alex_w: Great. action owners — please update the board and ping me with blockers. Monthly follow-up scheduled in #eng-platform on 2026-04-10.

maria_p: Added calendar invite and recurring reminder. :calendar:

sam_k: I'll start the scoping PR today. :thumbsup:

alex_w: Thanks all. Let's minimize blast radius & get better auto-rollback hygiene. :white_check_mark:
